description: Award Travel Finder is a travel search service focused on finding award-flight availability and related loyalty-program data using points and miles. It offers tools for AI agents and developers to search award seats, compare redemptions, and work with airline and hotel program information.
summary: awardtravelfinder.com exposes a REST API at `https://awardtravelfinder.com/api/v1` authenticated by `X-API-Key`, plus MCP endpoints at `https://mcp.awardtravelfinder.com/mcp` and a root-host variant `https://awardtravelfinder.com/mcp`; docs and metadata describe OAuth 2.1 for the subdomain MCP endpoint, while a seed probe reported both MCP endpoints as public/no-auth.

surfaces.name: Award Travel Finder MCP Server (root endpoint)
